title: Evaluation, Safety, and Operations
description: Begins with a plain-language explanation of RAGAS, source attribution, privacy, and failure analysis, then traces the corresponding implementation and its limits in college-faq-chatbot-rag.
learning_objectives: Explain RAGAS, source attribution, privacy, and failure analysis in plain language and connect it to scripts/evaluate.py; src/evaluation/ragas_eval.py.
Trace one input through the evaluation, safety, and operations stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
concepts_covered: RAGAS, source attribution, privacy, and failure analysis
practical_outcomes: Trace the evaluation, safety, and operations stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for RAGAS, source attribution, privacy, and failure analysis.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
